Proposition
[second-order Jacobi equation]

Source: petersen:page-0117 ↗ lem:pet-ch3-jacobi-field-equivalent-equation ↗ cor:pet-ch3-radial-equation-distance-function ↗ def:pet-ch3-directional-curvature-operator

A Jacobi field $J$ satisfies $ abla _{\partial _r} abla _{\partial _r}J=-R(J,\partial _r)\partial _r$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch3-jacobi-second-order-equation

\sketch Differentiate $ abla _{\partial _r}J=S(J)$ along $\partial _r$:

\[ abla _{\partial _r}^2J=( abla _{\partial _r}S)(J)+S^2(J). \]

The radial equation subsection 2.3 identifies the right-hand side with $-R(J,\partial _r)\partial _r=-R_{\partial _r}(J)$ in the notation of subsection 1.3.

□
